visual_action: The video consists of two still images. The first shows Vice President Kamala Harris sitting at a desk with her husband, Doug Emhoff, standing beside her. She is smiling and pointing to the inside of a wooden desk drawer that is placed on top of the desk. The second image is a close-up of the drawer's interior, showing multiple signatures from previous vice presidents written directly on the wood.
